description: The payer and the seat's daily cap (swarm audit of 8ddc5d2, finding 13): the seat's daily cap bounds every call the seat's key pays for, whoever the call is for. A requester call must fit the per-call cap, the seat's daily cap and its job budget. imd-flop: `cap set <cap>` on a fresh ledger, then each run in order: `config set payer <payer>`, then `run --job <job>` (mock, the estimate {0.066 FLOP, 3 in, 8 out, max-tokens 8}, padded 0.186), with `--job-budget <job_budget>` when the run gives one. exits: the exit code of each run. spent_today: `cap show --json` spent_today_mock after the last run. spend-guard has no payer. The viewer decides no caps.
status: current behavior since the fix for finding 13 of the swarm audit of 8ddc5d2
